instructions: Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You will hear a conversation between a travel agent and a customer about a travel package.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: First, you have some time to read through questions one to three.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Now, listen carefully and answer questions one to three.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Good morning. This is Euro Travels. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi there. I'm interested in travelling to Spain this summer. I heard you have some specials on right now.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that is correct. Three of our travel packages to Spain are being offered at discount prices, but only for a limited time. The sale ends, um, next week Wednesday I believe.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, I think there was one package that focused on coastal areas, wasn't there?

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Oh yes, that's our coastal package. It's one of our most popular packages to Spain.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: You'll get to visit a lot of nice beaches along the coast. The length of the trip is eight days.
transcript.highlight_text: The length of the trip is eight days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's fine. I can only get ten days off work. So, what hotel would I be staying at?

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Oh, it's a lovely facility located in Marbella on the Costa del Sol. It's called the Los Parmas Resort. It's got beautiful views and beaches, excellent restaurants and is nearby a lot of interesting sites.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what is included in the package?

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Accommodation, air travel and meals and beverages are all inclusive. And the hotel can arrange local tours to historic sites, nature preserves and other beaches if you pay extra.
transcript.highlight_text: hotel can arrange local tours... if you pay extra.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do you happen to know how much they charge for those?

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Well, they are relatively inexpensive. From what I remember, the hotel charges 40 euro for them.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That all sounds good to me.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Well, the total cost would be $820 and we require a $200 deposit to hold the booking.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: You can pay the rest two weeks before your departure. Would you like to make a booking?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Um, I'd like to think about it first.

transcript.speaker: Travel Agent
transcript.text: Okay, not a problem. Call us back when you've made your decision.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You now have 15 seconds to check your answers.

questions.question_text: How long does the coastal package last?
questions.explanation: The travel agent explicitly states that 'the length of the trip is eight days'.

questions.question_text: What does the hotel charge extra for?
questions.explanation: The agent mentions that 'the hotel can arrange local tours... if you pay extra'.

questions.question_text: How much is the total cost of the package?
questions.explanation: The agent confirms that 'the total cost would be $820'.
